purpose: Describe report filtering, column construction, saved layouts, totals, permissions, and exports as one coherent result contract.

filter_contract.binding: Filter definitions supply field names, value kinds, defaults, requiredness, and reference targets where declared. Apply explicit caller values before computed defaults.
filter_contract.dependent_query: A dependent query obtains its options using current filter values and effective access. Changing a controlling filter may invalidate a dependent selection.
filter_contract.change_handler: A declared change handler may recalculate another filter, change requiredness, or refresh the result; its behavior belongs to the interaction component.
filter_contract.empty_and_missing: An omitted filter and an explicitly empty value remain distinct until the report procedure normalizes them.

column_contract.conditional_construction: Each column definition includes its construction scope and enclosing decisions. Include it only when the corresponding branch executes. Multiple definitions for the same field may represent mutually exclusive configurations.
column_contract.dynamic_columns: Period, warehouse, account, dimension, or other data-dependent columns are generated by the execution procedure. Preserve their construction order and complete labels.
column_contract.currency: Interpret a monetary column using its declared context field or report currency policy. A numeric total across different currencies is invalid unless the report explicitly converts them to a common currency.
column_contract.quantity: Preserve the stated stock unit or transaction unit. Aggregating quantities with incompatible units requires explicit conversion.
column_contract.reference_column: Link and dynamic-link columns retain both record identity and target type for authorized navigation. Display labels do not replace identities.

row_contract.ordering: Follow explicit report ordering including secondary keys. Row order cannot be inferred from database physical order.
row_contract.grouping: A group row or subtotal row must remain distinguishable from a transactional detail row. Hierarchy indentation is display information, not an additional ledger record.
row_contract.totals: Add a total row only where declared. Respect per-column exclusion flags and report-calculated totals; summing an already aggregated total twice is prohibited.
row_contract.saved_layout: A saved report layout provides ordered selected fields, filter predicates, ordering, and total-row settings. Interpret them through the named record definitions.

permission_contract.entry: A report must be available to the effective actor and not disabled.
permission_contract.records: Record restrictions are applied according to the report and execution contracts. The report catalog explicitly states whether its generic user-record restriction flag is enabled.
permission_contract.exports: Export uses the same authorized result and filters. It must not silently rerun an unrestricted query or add hidden protected fields.

prepared_execution: Prepared reports run against the recorded filter set and actor context according to background-work rules. Completion, freshness, stored result, and failure are separate states.
verification_obligation: A replacement must compare actual report results, totals, columns, and export values under relevant filter branches. Static metadata and recovered column definitions establish available structure; they do not certify every dynamic result.
